static_traits.name: Lin Shan
static_traits.family_status: 被收养,独生Female;与养家Relationship tension
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but finds it hard to discuss family topics; is cautious in interpersonal interaction and finds it hard to trust others
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;此前not yet接受过心理治疗或精神科治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑较好;语气谨慎,略显紧张;能进行自我Reflection与写作(记日记);配合度较高,倾向聚焦负面细节

basic_info.main_problem: 我挣扎于这样的信念:因为我被收养,我永远not会从家人那里获得真正的爱.
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not yet解决的'not被爱'感受已影响我的心理健康与整体幸福感,希望通过咨询改变相关负性思维模式并获得缓解.
growth_experiences: 被收养的家庭背景:自幼与养家建立情感联结困难,童年起持续感到疏离与not被爱;这些感受最初出现时压力水平较高,源于与养家联结的困难.
在多次Family gatherings或讨论收养话题的场合中,反复感到被忽视与'not属于',负性情绪累积;最近一次Family gatherings中更显孤立与without人注意,进一步Reinforcement了'not会得到家人的真正爱'的信念.与此同时也存在支持片段,如资助大学学费,庆祝成就,住院时的照料,但常被负面经历所淹not.

core_beliefs: 我永远not会得到家人的真正爱

special_situations.event: 最近一次Family gatherings中,来访者感觉without人注意,格格not入
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在Family gatherings里have not被关注或被看见,就证明家人not爱我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在聚会中保持疏离,减少互动以Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们并not真正爱我,我只是出于义务被邀请

special_situations.event: Discussing adoption-related topics within the family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我是被收养的,我就永远not会真正属于这个家也not会被真正爱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过写日记和自我Reflection试图厘清与控制这些念头
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 因为我被收养,他们只是尽责任,not会真正在乎我

special_situations.event: Recalls the support family once gave (funding tuition, celebrating achievements, caring during hospitalization)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有持续,毫without例外的关爱才算真实的爱;偶尔的支持not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视或negate积极证据,专注负面经历以维持Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些支持只是例外,not代表他们真的爱我

special_situations.event: Situations of building intimate relationships with others (friends or colleagues getting close)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果让do not人靠近,我最终会Being rejected或受伤
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping distance, avoiding deep trust and intimacy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will reject me sooner or later

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被家人without条件地接纳与爱,获得稳固的归属感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected,被忽视与情感上的抛弃
defense_goal: 通过保持疏离与Self-protection来降低Being rejected的风险,避免再度受伤

object_relations.self_representation: 被忽视的外人/not被爱的孩子
object_relations.object_representation: Indifferent caregivers (family) who only fulfill obligations

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当在Family gatherings中感到without人关注或被忽视时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously equating the family's indifference with complete rejection, believing they are only cared for out of 'obligation'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用笃定的语气重复'他们not爱我',回避探讨其他可能性或正向证据.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite recalling support given by family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的邀请理解为在淡化或deny她的痛苦与Being rejected体验
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以冷静,客观的语气罗列事实,尽量not涉及感受,语气平淡,情感强度低.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When external relationships show signs of closeness or intimacy (friends or colleagues being more proactive)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把对方的靠近理解为潜在的伤害前奏,认为'迟早会Being rejected'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explains with reasons such as 'to protect myself' that keeping distance is necessary, tone cautious, emphasizing potential risks and consequences.

manifestations: 在Family gatherings中感到格格not入与without人注意
难以信任他人,害怕Being rejected,减少亲密接触
长期体验到'not被爱,not属于'的存在性Sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将自身'not被爱'的Fear归因于家人:认为他们只是出于义务而非真正关爱
在聚会中以读心方式断定他人not在乎自己

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在Interpersonal relationships中保持高度警惕与谨慎,难以让他人靠近
担心Being rejected而降低主动接触,影响日常互动

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 想要寻求家人的安慰与支持却克制,转而通过写日记和自我Reflection来处理情绪
When an intimate relationship gets close, suppresses the impulse to express needs and chooses self-isolation

exception_events.target_problem: 在家庭场景或谈及收养时,来访者通常会认为自己not被爱并陷入孤立与Low mood.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When previously hospitalized, the family visited continuously and gave practical support and care; interactions were closer and responses timely.
exception_events.reason: not同情境:健康危机促使家人集中投入时间与精力;not同支持:家人以具体陪伴与照料提供情感与现实支持.

exception_events.target_problem: 在多数家庭互动中,来访者通常会将家人的支持行为Interpretation为'出于义务',从而negate积极意义.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During university, the family proactively funded tuition and celebrated their achievements; continuous resource investment and positive feedback showed care and recognition.
exception_events.reason: not同做法:家人以长期,实质的经济支持与仪式性庆祝表达关爱;not同理解:可将此视为关系承诺与价值肯定的证据.
